speed_model: model estimate: each axis <= $VEL_AXIS % of its URDF velocity (unverified) and $ACC_AXIS % of the assumed axis_acc_deg_s2; path rate = trapezoid in s (cruise min_j(v_j/|dq_j|), ramps min_j(a_j/|dq_j|)); peak TCP speed = max |dx/ds| * rate; controller profile not modelled
clearance_note: move_min_clearance_mm: retract / approach LINs are checked with the tip exempt from the bed (they start on the print); PTP and lift / lower LINs with the tip included
